python -I -c "
import pandas as pd,numpy as np
c=pd.read_csv('counts.tsv',sep='\t',index_col=0);s=pd.read_csv('samples.csv').set_index('sample_id')
print(c.to_string(),c.isna().sum().sum())
p=c.div(c.sum(1),axis=0)
H=-(p*np.log(p.where(p>0,1))).sum(1)
print(H);print(H.groupby(s.facies).mean().to_dict())
"
